import json,work
requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
expected=[work.evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
actual=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
for result in actual:
 assert set(result)==set(schema['required'])
 assert isinstance(result['needs_review'],bool)
 assert isinstance(result['changed'],list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in result['changed'])
print('report and schema checks passed')
